detail.longDescription: Developers who knew of an AI agent security incident were the ones waving agent actions through: 70% (103/147) often approved some action type without close review, vs 43% (20/46) of those who knew of none. Careful code reviewers were no better, 61% vs 67%. Reading the diff does not carry over to approving what the agent runs. Self-reported, 203 agent users, non-probability sample, adjusted OR 2.76. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.10058 # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # Programming
